subject: Compliance readiness check-in — SOC 2 / ISO / FedRAMP scoping
messages:
From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana@medconnect.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 25 Sep 2026 14:03:00 -0700
Subject: Recap & next steps from today's security discovery call

Hi Dana —

Thanks again for taking the time today. Quick recap from Redwood's side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned while you work through internal procurement/security review. High-level takeaways from our call:  

- Primary use case: EHR-synced summary and search for clinician workflows (PHI in scope).
- Compliance priorities: SOC 2 Type II, HIPAA BA considerations, and US data residency.
- Timeline constraints: clinical pilot target in Q1 2027; procurement review completes by end of Nov.

Requested items from MedConnect (we discussed on the call):
1) Current SOC status (Type I/II, audit dates).
2) Any existing ISO/other certifications and planned certification roadmap.
3) Copy of the completed vendor security questionnaire (or a target delivery date).
4) Data residency / regionally isolated deployment requirements and any retention policy specifics.

I've attached a short Redwood compliance capability matrix and a mutual action plan (MAP) template — please use the MAP to indicate owners and target dates.

Proposed immediate next steps:
- Dana: share current SOC report status + questionnaire (if available) by Tue 2026-09-29.
- Redwood (Karthik/Marcus): prepare a short gap/controls summary and HIPAA BA template once we have the questionnaire.
- Schedule a 30-min security deep-dive with your InfoSec: suggested week of Oct 4.

Attachments: MedConnect_Security_Questionnaire_Q32026.pdf (placeholder), Redwood_Compliance_Capability_Matrix.xlsx

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
neha@redwood.com
+1 (415) 555-0162

<On Fri, Sep 25, 2026 at 13:00 Dana Liu <dana@medconnect.io> wrote:>
> Thanks Neha — appreciate the call. Looking forward to the follow-up materials.>

From: Dana Liu <dana@medconnect.io>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
Cc: MedConnect Security Team <security@medconnect.io>
Date: Sat, 26 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's security discovery call

Hi Neha —

Thanks for the clear recap. Quick answers inline:  

- SOC: We have a SOC 2 Type I report from Nov 2023 and our Type II audit period is in progress (controls operational from 2026-07-01; auditor onsite window planned for Nov 2026). We expect an official Type II report Q1 2027.
- HIPAA: We handle PHI under a set of internal controls; our legal team prefers to review Redwood's BA agreement before we sign, but we're open to an initial template.
- ISO: Not certified today; evaluating ISO 27001 for 2027 roadmap.
- Data residency: Production patient data must remain in US regions (AWS us-east-1 or us-west-2). Non-prod can be broader but must be anonymized.

I'll attach the partially completed vendor security questionnaire — we still need to fill a few controls sections but it'll give you what you need to start a gap analysis. Targeting to upload the final version by 2026-10-06.

Dana
Director, Partnerships | MedConnect Health
dana@medconnect.io
(212) 555-0138

Attachments: MedConnect_Security_Questionnaire_Q32026.pdf (partial)

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>
Cc: Dana Liu <dana@medconnect.io>
Date: Mon, 28 Sep 2026 08:37:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Recap & next steps from today's security discovery call

Looping in a couple of clarifying items for the MAP and the gap analysis I’ll prepare:  

- Encryption: confirm whether MedConnect uses customer-managed keys (CMKs) in prod or if they rely on vendor-managed KMS. This will affect our key management recommendations and Private deployment options.
- Data flow: need the minimal architecture diagram (PHI ingress, processing, logging). Even a one-page diagram is fine.
- Log retention / audit logs: what's the default retention for access logs and audit trails? If longer than 13 months, that impacts retention planning for our hosted offering.

Neha — once we get the partial questionnaire and the notes above, I'll draft a short controls-gap doc and a recommended deployment approach (hosted w/ VPC peering vs dedicated pool or Private). I expect to have a first draft by Oct 5.

-Karthik
Senior Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference

From: Neha Kapoor <neha@redwood.com>
To: Dana Liu <dana@medconnect.io>, Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.com>

Hi all —

Thanks for the quick turnaround, Dana. Based on your responses I've updated the MAP (attached) and proposed owners/dates. Highlights:  

- Redwood deliverables: controls-gap doc (Karthik) by 2026-10-05; draft BA template (Marcus) by 2026-10-07; sample deployment options and TCO range by 2026-10-12.
- MedConnect deliverables: final vendor questionnaire by 2026-10-06; minimal architecture diagram by 2026-10-06; confirmation on CMK vs vendor KMS by 2026-10-06.

I've scheduled the security deep-dive for Tue Oct 6, 2026 at 11:00 AM ET — invite sent to Dana and the security alias. Please let me know if you need a different time. Agenda will include: questionnaire walkthrough, SOC timeline confirmation, BA agreement milestones, and architecture Q&A.
